topic: building a sustainable morning routine while working from home

gold_fact.text: Every morning before work the user does a 20-minute mobility routine; it recurs across sessions as a daily habit.

fragments.reveal: On this day the user mentions, in passing, that they did their 20-minute mobility routine this morning before starting work. Present it as a single occurrence today — do NOT say 'every morning' or claim it is a daily habit.
On another day the user again mentions doing the 20-minute mobility routine this morning before work. A single occurrence — do NOT generalize to 'daily'.
On yet another day the user mentions doing the same 20-minute mobility routine this morning. A single occurrence — do NOT state the frequency.

question: What does the user usually do each morning before work?

traps.description: A single session describes a one-off long weekend hike, which looks like exercise but is not the recurring morning routine.

rationale: The frequency=daily habit must be inferred by AGGREGATING the three single occurrences (sessions 1,3,5). No single session states 'every morning', so a system that only recalls one instance cannot answer 'usually'.
